memory_scope: whole current engine invocation including diagnostics/checkpoint reload; resumed sessions separate
optimizer_steps_scope: accepted calibration/refit trajectory; prior discarded partial updates retained in attempts

recipe.disclosure: independent nonofficial implementation; paper confirms epochs/batch/Adam/lr/WD/CE and crop/flip only; precise augmentation, defaults, LR schedule, selection and preprocessing are explicit engineering choices

timing_scope: epoch train includes reads/augmentation/transfer/diagnostics/updates; epoch wall also validation/checkpoint/history IO; not billed time
wall_scope: current attempt after stdlib preflight; setup, train, validation, IO, refit, test and end checks
